_note: No PostToolUse rebuild hook, deliberately. One used to point at tools/claude-rebuild-on-edit.sh — a script that does not exist in this repo — with async:true, so for ~2 months every edit fired a hook that failed silently and rebuilt nothing. Nothing actually depended on it: tools/mcp-server/package.json sets both `main` and `bin` to src/index.ts, so the server always runs from SOURCE, and its dist/ is vestigial gitignored build output with no loader anywhere. If rebuild-on-edit is wanted again, add the script FIRST, and drop async so a failure is visible instead of silent.
